allow: PowerShell($ghPath = \(Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\GitHub CLI\\" -Filter "gh.exe" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1\).FullName; if \(-not $ghPath\) { $ghPath = \(Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\GitHub CLI\\" -Filter "gh.exe" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1\).FullName }; Write-Output $ghPath)

PowerShell(Expand-Archive -Path "$env:TEMP\\gh.zip" -DestinationPath "C:\\gh-cli" -Force; $ghExe = Get-ChildItem "C:\\gh-cli" -Filter "gh.exe" -Recurse | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; Write-Output "gh.exe 位置: $ghExe"; & $ghExe --version)
